build.beforeBuildCommand: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),d='src-tauri/target/release/bundle/macos';try{for(const f of fs.readdirSync(d))if(f.startsWith('rw.')&&f.endsWith('.dmg'))fs.rmSync(d+'/'+f)}catch(e){}" && npm run build
